title: Landed comments and changeset state that a publish-time lint refuses the surviving `controlled_by_parent` master shapes — it does not, so the documented blast-radius bound is false today
body:
Found while implementing #8880 (docs-only, direction 1). Filed unassigned — recording it, not claiming it. No runtime behaviour is wrong here; the **stated bound on that behaviour** is.

## The claim

Three landed artifacts assert, in the present tense, that a publish-time lint refuses the declarable shapes on which `assertControlledByParentWrite` still answers `422 MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD`:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts:5113` — *"The residual envelope asymmetry is confined to exactly those shapes, which #8772's lint now refuses at publish time."*
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/errors.ts:182` — *"#8772's lint refuses those shapes at publish time; until an app is …"*
- `.changeset/cbp-missing-master-insert-validation-envelope.md:64` — *"…precisely the shapes #8772's lint now refuses at publish time. An app that publishes cleanly sees one envelope"* — this one is **release-note-bound**, so the false claim is scheduled to ship to users.

The card #8880 repeats it as the reason its blast radius is bounded: *"these shapes are what #8772's lint refuses at publish, so newly authored metadata cannot reach them."*

## What is actually true on `main`

#8772 is **open** (`pm:queue`) — no lint landed. Measured on `main` at `d6e80b28b`:

| surviving 422 shape | publish-time lint verdict today |
|---|---|
| `master_detail`, no `required` | `severity: 'warning'` — `relationship/master-detail-required`, `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts:491-499` |
| `master_detail` + `required` + `readonly` | **nothing** — no rule reads `readonly` in `data-model-rules.ts` |
| `master_detail` + `required` + `system` | **nothing** — no rule reads `system` in `data-model-rules.ts` |
| required-`lookup` fallback relation | **nothing** — `validate-security-posture.ts:313` only refuses a `controlled_by_parent` object with *no* resolvable relation at all |

```ts
// packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts:489-499 — the only rule in the family
if (type === 'master_detail') {
  if (def.required !== true) {
    issues.push({
      severity: 'warning',
      rule: 'relationship/master-detail-required',
```

A warning does not gate `os compile`, and three of the four shapes are not reported at all.

## Why it matters

The sentence is load-bearing, not decorative. It is the reason the residual envelope asymmetry reads as acceptable in the landed rationale: a residue confined to shapes nobody can newly author is a shrinking legacy tail, while a residue any new app can declare today is a live, growing surface. Only the second is true. Concretely, a freshly authored object that declares `master_detail` + `required` + `readonly` publishes clean — no warning, no error — and its inserts answer `422 MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD` with no `fields[]`, against a catalog that documents that code as 400-with-`fields[]`.

This also means #8772 is not merely a hardening nicety; it is the precondition the already-landed reasoning assumes.

## Directions (for triage, not a recommendation)

1. Correct the three artifacts to the conditional/future tense they actually mean (*"the shapes #8772 proposes to refuse"*), so the landed rationale stops claiming a bound that does not exist. Cheapest, and independent of how #8772 is ruled.
2. Land #8772 (any of its directions 1–2), which makes the present tense true and retires this card with it.
3. Both — 1 now, since the changeset is release-note-bound and ships before #8772 can plausibly land.

Note the changeset is already merged, so direction 1 there is a correction to a pending release note rather than to an unreleased file.

Related: #8772 (the unlanded lint this text presumes) · #8880 (the docs card that surfaced it; its docs prose is being written against the *measured* state, not this claim) · #8688 / PR #8879 (where the text landed).
